The Shade design system

A dark-first design system for desktop work tools, with a matching light mode. Thirteen colour roles, one accent, Inter at five sizes, a 4 px grid and 28 px controls, built as Avalonia components.

01 / Colors

Colour roles

Thirteen roles named by their job, plus the shades the rules make from them. Every value below is read from the code, for the mode you're viewing.

From the page to the lines on it.

Separator#35353D#DADAE1Every resting 1 px line
Outline#606069#A7A7AFA control's border on hover or while open

Three steps of emphasis, and Disabled.

Text 2#B1B1BC#474752Labels, supporting text
Text 3#9999A7#676775Placeholders, metadata, hints

The app's one colour and what the rules make from it.

Accent#8C7AE6#8C7AE6Primary action, selection, focus, the active tab
Accent hover#9887E8#9887E8The Primary button under the pointer

Status

Fixed per mode; never the accent.

Success#83CEA5#1F8A57OK, completed
Warning#FFB142#A86400Retrying, incomplete
Danger#E0685C#C4453AFailed, deletes, actions that change the outside world
Danger tint#392729#F6E3E1The Danger button's fill
Info#6FA8DC#2C6CB0Overrides, notices

Rules

Shades are computed, never stored.

  • Tint: 15 % of a colour over Raised.
  • Hover: 10 % lighter.
  • On a colour: dark ink or white, whichever reads better.
  • Lifted text: accent and danger text move toward the high-contrast end until 4.5:1.
  • A status colour always sits next to its word.

02 / Typography

Type scale

Inter for the interface, Cascadia Code for values. Five sizes, nothing in between.

Scale

A size between steps is rounded to the nearest.

Daily yield 1 234,56 kWh
Title · 18 px · 600 · Page and dialog titles
Daily yield 1 234,56 kWh
Section · 14 px · 600 · Block and card headings
Daily yield 1 234,56 kWh
Body · 13 px · 400 · Fields, table cells, running text
Daily yield 1 234,56 kWh
Label · 12 px · 500 · Labels, table headers, buttons
Daily yield 1 234,56 kWh
Caption · 11 px · 400 · Help, metadata

Weights

Weight carries emphasis before size does.

Inter 400 · Run now
Inter 500 · Run now
Inter 600 · Run now
Inter 700 · Run now

Mono

Cascadia Code without ligatures: addresses, registers, code.

01 06 00 0A 00 64
127.0.0.1:502 · 0-0:1.8.0
{ "method": "host.get", "limit": 5 }

Writing

How labels read.

  • Sentence case: “Create job”, not “Create Job”.
  • Actions are verbs and never end in dots: “Sync”.
  • Work in progress keeps them: “Connecting…”.

Components

Rendered from the real controls in the mode you're viewing. One implementation each, every state shown.

ComponentCodeRule
ButtonsBtn, Capsule, IconButtonOne Primary per area; Danger for deletes and outside-world actions
FieldsField, HostPortField, SuggestionFieldRaised fill; only the frame changes
Dropdowns and menusChoiceButton, MultiChoice, MenuOpen, field and list are one shape
Switches and ticksSwitch, Tick, StateToggleA switch acts now; a tick is a choice for Save

05 / Responsive

Responsive

Blocks reflow into as many masonry columns as fit; the sidebar collapses to its icons. This page does the same: resize the window.

06 / Navigation

Navigation

The sidebar says where you are; each page owns its title and actions; tabs switch views of one thing; Back returns.
